description: Permanently delete one session — its frames, transcript and bundle — from disk. This cannot be undone and there is no confirmation step, so only call it when the user asked for that session to be deleted. The original recording archived under ~/.talkthru/archive is left alone. To free disk while keeping the frames and narration, the user wants `talkthru compact` instead, not this.

session_id.description: Session id to delete, e.g. 20260803-001500-a1b2c3. Not a file path.

name: delete_session
title: Delete a narrated session
